value_scale.note: Whether pixels are scaled to [0,1] before normalization is not specified in 06_ML_SYSTEM.md; do not assume.

normalization.note: Facial preprocessing normalization (per-channel mean/std) is NOT specified in 06_ML_SYSTEM.md. Source it from the facial model's preprocessing config (e.g. the HuggingFace image processor for the base model). Do NOT invent values.

face_detection.note: Face detection and cropping happen BEFORE this contract. The ONNX expects an already-cropped, resized face crop; the model is not a full pipeline (no detection/softmax/scoring inside it).
